item.title: বলিউড অভিনেতা ইমরানের ভারত ছাড়ার নির্দেশে স্থগিতাদেশ

item.title: Brazil's Political Future Discussed After Lula's Election Win
item.description: Following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's runoff victory in Brazil's presidential election, Guardian correspondent Tom Phillips addresses reader inquiries about the nation's trajectory.

item.title: জামায়াত নেতা মানিক পশারীর দাফনে বাধা নিয়ে তদন্ত কমিটি গঠিত
item.description: মানিক পশারীর দাফনে বাধা দেওয়ার ঘটনায় জামায়াত একটি তদন্ত কমিটি গঠন করেছে। কেন্দ্রীয় নেতা সাইফুল আলম খান ও নূরুল ইসলাম বুলবুলকে তিন দিনের মধ্যে প্রতিবেদন জমা দিতে বলা হয়েছে।

item.title: Sreedharan Urges Kerala to Dismiss Rail Panel Concerns
item.description: Technocrat Sreedharan advised the Kerala administration to disregard a technical committee's reservations regarding the high-speed railway initiative, arguing the plan lacked proper review.

item.title: Centre Considers Child Pornography Legislation in Supreme Court
item.description: The central government informed the Supreme Court it is weighing a law addressing child pornography. This follows an NGO's petition highlighting insufficient protections and the sharing of assault videos.

item.title: Tehran Evaluates Strategy Amid Anticipated US Tensions
item.description: Iran maintains its core demands amidst diplomatic efforts to avert a broader crisis related to the ongoing US-Israeli situation, keeping focus on key strategic factors.

item.title: HYDRAA Eliminates Seven Borewells Near Fox Sagar
item.description: Authorities from HYDRAA dismantled seven borewells situated in the vicinity of the Fox Sagar water body.

item.title: Ceasefire Starts in Ukrainian City After Severe Hardship
item.description: A truce brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump has begun in Oleshky. The ceasefire aims to facilitate civilian evacuations and humanitarian aid deliveries to residents.

item.title: খুলনায় ১৭ ঘণ্টায় তিনজনকে গুলি করার ঘটনা
item.description: খুলনায় সোমবার রাত থেকে মঙ্গলবার বিকেল পর্যন্ত ১৭ ঘণ্টার ভেতর তিনটি পৃথক গোলাগুলির ঘটনা ঘটে। এতে যুবদলের দুই নেতাসহ মোট তিনজন গুলিবিদ্ধ হয়েছেন।

item.title: Apple AirTag Available at Record Low Price Ahead of Holidays
item.description: Apple's newest AirTag tracking device has dropped to its lowest price yet. The discount arrives as shoppers prepare for upcoming holiday travel and luggage tracking needs.

item.title: Traders cautioned over artificial rice shortages amid surging costs
item.description: Authorities have issued warnings to merchants to prevent deliberate supply shortages as grain prices climb. The directive aims to protect consumers from unfair market manipulation.

item.title: Maine resident wins federal case regarding defective foreclosure notice
item.description: A federal court ruled that foreclosure notification rules protect non-borrowing spouses in Maine. The decision helped a woman facing property loss following her husband's refinancing.

item.title: California river receives 24,000 cubic yards of gravel for salmon
item.description: Restoration teams placed more than 24,000 cubic yards of gravel into the Lower Tuolumne River to enhance biodiversity. Salmon began spawning in the newly improved habitat just days later.

item.title: Israeli voter turnout reaches half-century high as polls proceed
item.description: Mid-afternoon figures showed nearly 45 percent participation in Israel's ongoing elections. This represents the highest turnout recorded in fifty years.

item.title: Nordic Leaders Discuss Ukraine Conflict with Putin
item.description: The prime ministers of Finland and Norway held a direct conversation with Vladimir Putin concerning potential peace negotiations to resolve the war in Ukraine. Finnish leader Alexander Stubb additionally conferred with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

item.title: India Clinches T20I Series Victory in New Zealand Following Strong Opening Start
item.description: A rapid partnership by opening batters Abhishek and Sooryavanshi secured a series win for India against New Zealand. The duo amassed 132 runs within the initial seven overs of their second-innings target chase.

item.title: FATHI calls on authorities to disburse pending RTF funds
item.description: The organization has formally requested the government to release outstanding RTF payments. No further details regarding the delay were provided.

item.title: Complications arise surrounding chief adviser appointment process
item.description: Uncertainty has developed regarding the mechanism for selecting the chief adviser. Discussions on the matter are ongoing among relevant parties.

item.title: Poovamma selected to receive the Vandana Award
item.description: Poovamma has been named as the recipient of the Vandana Award. The recognition honors her achievements in her respective field.

item.title: Rajshahi fertilizer shop reopens under police protection
item.description: A fertilizer shop in Rajshahi's Paba upazila that closed due to threats from local political faction followers has resumed operations. Law enforcement officers were present to ensure safety during the reopening.

item.title: Bhuvneshwar reflects on India return after long hiatus
item.description: Returning to the Indian squad for the first time since November 2022, the 36-year-old fast bowler expressed pride in his comeback. Across three recent matches, he managed to secure a single dismissal.

item.title: Teen develops AI tool to log thousands of road hazards
item.description: Motivated by his parents' injuries in a crash, a 16-year-old created an artificial intelligence system that logged nearly 3,000 road defects in three cities and monitored 190 fixes.

item.title: Aavin raises prices on numerous dairy items before Deepavali
item.description: Ahead of the Deepavali festival, Aavin has bumped up rates for approximately 25 dairy goods. Specifically, curd rose by ₹10 per kilogram, and ghee climbed by ₹80 per kilogram.

item.title: পরিবারে উৎকণ্ঠা: সৌদিতে দণ্ডপ্রাপ্ত বাংলাদেশির ভিডিও ছড়ালেন পশ্চিমবঙ্গের সাহাবুদ্দিন
item.description: মক্কার এক মসজিদে অবমাননার অভিযোগে ২০২৩ সালে সৌদি আরবে গ্রেপ্তার হন পশ্চিমবঙ্গের অভিবাসী শ্রমিক শেখ সাহাবুদ্দিন। তাঁর মৃত্যুদণ্ডের ভিডিও ছড়িয়ে পড়ার পর তাঁর পরিবারে গভীর দুশ্চিন্তা দেখা দিয়েছে।

item.title: Honda cautions that half-percent Canadian tariffs spell disaster
item.description: Donald Trump warned he may raise vehicle and auto part tariffs from 25% to 50% absent a new trade agreement. Honda stated this steep hike would severely damage the automotive sector in Canada.

item.title: Court directs status quo regarding passport seizure notice for KTR
item.description: A Telangana law officer told the court that KTR only received a show-cause notice regarding his passport seizure amid an ACB probe. Following this, the bench mandated a status quo.

item.title: Memorial event for Dr. Suresh Surathkal scheduled for October 29
item.description: An upcoming memorial event dedicated to Dr. Suresh Surathkal is scheduled to take place on the 29th of October.

item.title: High Court warns Chief Secretary over potential non-compliance
item.description: The High Court stated that the Chief Secretary must appear in person if a specific bench directive remains unfulfilled by the fourth of November.

item.title: JetBlue Reports Higher Financial Loss Due to Fuel Expenses
item.description: JetBlue Airways recorded an increased financial loss driven by rising fuel expenses. Despite this, the chief executive officer noted that company margins are showing signs of progress under a current restructuring strategy.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi Prepares Memoir to Share Her Own Perspective
item.description: Ex-Congress leader Sonia Gandhi stated that her upcoming book will spark a public spectacle because she is finally sharing her own version of events after years of accounts by others.

item.title: Boeing Shares Drop 9 Percent Amid 737 Max Output Delay
item.description: Boeing equity fell nine percent following the manufacturer's announcement that 737 Max output will not scale up substantially until late 2027. The disclosure precedes a scheduled investor briefing on quarterly financial results.

item.title: Kadri Park Hosts Three-Day Siri Horticulture Festival
item.description: The Siri Horticulture Festival is scheduled to begin its three-day run at Kadri Park starting October 30.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Strikes Eastern Coast of India
item.description: The eastern coast of India experienced severe precipitation and coastal inundation on Tuesday as cyclone Arnab made landfall.

item.title: C.T. Ravi Challenges Congress Over Electoral Officer Legal Actions
item.description: Politician C.T. Ravi challenged the Congress party to initiate legal proceedings against booth level and electoral registration officers. He emphasized that the electoral roll revision is a decentralized constitutional duty handled by state officials.

item.title: Israeli Forces Apprehend Egyptian Border Crosser
item.description: Israeli troops arrested an Egyptian citizen who crossed the frontier near Nitzana. Authorities have not yet determined the reason for the individual crossing the border.

item.title: Hyderabad Police Establish Special Unit for Major Offenses
item.description: Hyderabad law enforcement has established a specialized division dedicated to investigating major offenses. This move enables local officers to concentrate on public safety and crime prevention.

item.title: Hegseth Visits Manila to Strengthen US Regional Partnerships
item.description: Hegseth traveled to Manila to reinforce American alliances with Asia-Pacific allies. Regional nations are reassessing their strategies in light of the Iran conflict and criticisms from Trump.

item.title: Toddler dies by drowning after wandering away from residence
item.description: A young child left unattended at home wandered outside and tragically drowned in a nearby pond.

item.title: Shashil Namoshi secures fifth victory in North-East Teachers Constituency
item.description: The BJP candidate surpassed his Congress opponent Sharanappa Mattur by 3,297 votes, achieving the required quota during the initial round of first preference counting.

item.title: Dakshina Kannada publishes final voter list featuring 16.78 lakh electors
item.description: The official electoral rolls for Dakshina Kannada have been finalized, registering a total of 16.78 lakh eligible voters.

item.title: Ghaziabad police arrest 25-year-old over fatal road rage incident
item.description: Authorities detained a suspect for the killing of 32-year-old Himanshu Chaudhary from Jalalpur. The victim was riding his scooty home from his workplace when the altercation occurred.

item.title: Proposed F1 engine rules feature streamlined and cost-effective V8 hybrids
item.description: Upcoming Formula 1 regulations are slated to bring in V8 turbo hybrid power units designed to be less costly and less complex than current specifications.

item.title: High court orders government to submit status report on cemeteries
item.description: The judiciary has instructed the state administration to provide an official report concerning local burial grounds.

item.title: American Airlines increases credit card reward fees for the first time since 2018
item.description: Following industry trends among financial institutions and carriers, American Airlines has elevated annual charges for one of its primary reward cards.

item.title: Chitradurga district selected as site for region's inaugural tribal university
item.description: The state government plans to establish its very first tribal university within the Chitradurga district.
